command:
set -eu
BASE=/workspace/omega_runtime/extensions/ingress_v5
LOG=/workspace/omega_runtime/state/logs/ingress_gateway_v5.log
umask 077
tmux new-session -d -s omega-ingress "cd $BASE && PYTHONPATH=. exec python3 -m omega.ingress_gateway serve --owner gabriel --machine omega-vps --port 8787 >>$LOG 2>&1"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request,urllib.error,time,subprocess
t=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/private/ingress-gabriel.token').read_text().strip()
q=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t})
for i in range(20):
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(q,timeout=2) as r:
   print('RESTORED_V5_HTTP',r.status)
   break
 except Exception:time.sleep(.25)
else:raise AssertionError('FAIL_TO_RESTORE')
print('TMUX_PRESENT',subprocess.run(['tmux','has-session','-t','omega-ingress'],capture_output=True).returncode==0)
try:urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/health',timeout=2)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print('NO_TOKEN',e.code);assert e.code==401
else:raise AssertionError('AUTH_BYPASS')
PY
